requirement: Use one configured platform-owned Twilio voice number across tenants, with globally unique six-digit extensions resolving only to explicitly published active tenant/user voice destinations. Reuse the inherited communication core and binary adapter boundary. Do not buy numbers, publish user extensions, grant permissions, or mount unregistered endpoints during contract registration.

rules.voiceIdentity: primecare_ plus SHA-256 of length-prefixed tenant and user identifiers

releaseGates: Twilio account and secure credentials configured
Concrete shared number and recurring/usage charges approved before purchase
Governed extension assignment and publication with global uniqueness
Provider webhook and Voice SDK token contracts registered before mounting
Current tenant/user voice permissions and destination revocation checks
Live inbound/outbound provider and device acceptance
